scope: confirmation of P2 near-misses only: o M8 v18s (4,8,2,1) NT1024; router M16 routertail S16/WK4
pre_registered_rule: route iff, in this fresh run, median >= 1.015 and >= 75% of 16 paired wins, after the same correctness gates (o: v18s_plan; router: 64 one-hot columns exact, relL2 <= 2.5e-5). Written before the check.
adoption_rule: if both P4_USE fire and the check passes, the frozen routes become a scored-submission candidate only after a second confirming run shows the same per-shape direction (judge per-shape ratios for (8,o) and (16,router)); expected score gain ~0.2%, inside judge CI
